QuestInfo.name: Todd's How-to-Hunt
QuestInfo.0: You hear that #b#p7##k can teach you how to hunt...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p7##k asked me to defeat #r#o1#s#k, then talk to #b#p6##k.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the monsters, just as #b#p7##k instructed.

0.0: A new traveler, eh? Want to learn how to hunt? The #r#o1#s#k you see here are normally too powerful for you to handle, but #p313#, the head of all magicians, sealed up their power. So take down three, pick up what they drop, and go see #b#p6##k, who should be around here somewhere.

yes.0: Look at your mini map (#bM#k), located at the top left corner of the screen. You should see something green blinking on the northeast side of the map. That's #b#p6##k. You'll run into Jr. Sentinels on your way to meet #b#p6##k. Defeat them, pick up 3 #t4000000#s, then talk to #b#p6##k.

no.0: Oh, you know how to hunt already? Well, you can still test your abilities!

1.0: Are you the one #p7# is training? He mentioned you... Let's see if you've trained correctly.

yes.0:
Someday, long after you leave this place, you'll be powerful enough to take on real Jr. Sentinels. Oh, and when you level up, check your #bAbility Points#k in your Character Info. 
To move on to the next map, either press the #bup arrow key#k in front of the portal to the right or just talk to me again.

npc.0: What? Haven't you gone to #b#p6##k yet? You need to defeat #r3 #o1#s#k and take #b3 #t4000000##k with you!

item.0: Huh? You're not carrying #b3 #t4000000##k. After you've defeated a #r#o1##k, it'll drop a #t4000000#. Then press #rZ#k to pick up the item.

mob.0: Hmm, you should have seen a small #r#o1##k at the bottom of the map. Press #rCtrl#k to attack it. Pick up the item it drops once you defeat it, and then come talk to me.
